text: also like if its something like $5 to pay github and all these problems vanish because they will take the file size / storage total then id honestly take that for the sake of reducing headache but idk if that is a thing at all
resolution: Verified from current GitHub documentation that Free already includes 10 GiB of LFS storage and bandwidth and that paying for Pro would not lift ordinary Git's hard limits. The user then explicitly chose the direct LAN service instead, so no LFS or billing-dependent changes were made.
